newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt plans mobile phone firm with private sector.
newsitem.headline: Egypt plans mobile phone firm with private sector.

text.p: Egypt's cabinet on Monday decided to increase the private sector role in telecommunications by approving plans for it to take part in a mobile telephone firm, state television said.

It said initial studies envisaged the state taking a stake of about 30 percent in the new company. It gave no date for its launch, but said the project would develop in stages and was aimed at expanding the mobile phone network to other provinces.
Egypt last November launched a GSM mobile phone network in Cairo.
In November, U.S. telecommunications firm Lucent Technologies and the Egyptian government signed a memorandum of understanding to set up 260,000 new telephones lines in Cairo.
That project is part of a five-year plan to add five million lines across the country.
